research.summary: OpenLiteSpeed is the open-source edition of LiteSpeed Web Server (repository litespeedtech/openlitespeed), an event-driven HTTP/1.x, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 server with a built-in WebAdmin console. The vendor publishes a release log that categorizes each branch as Latest, Stable or Archived and states in prose when the archived 1.7.x branch stopped being maintained; it publishes no lifecycle table, no dated EOL table and no machine-readable lifecycle feed. This record covers the open-source server only, not LiteSpeed Web Server Enterprise.
research.notes: Tier: researched, not derived. The preserved vendor sentence says OpenLiteSpeed 1.7.x was archived and no longer maintained as of September 2025; it supports a vendor-stated EOL month of 2025-09, not a separate security-support date, so eossec remains null. Month precision is preserved and excluded from exact-day feeds/OpenEoX. The live page now shows only undated branch categories; the dated sentence is retained as stale evidence retrieved 2026-09-17 and this record must be installed with --allow-stale-evidence. No date is transferred to 1.6.x or older branches. No GA, EOS, or duration/trigger derivation is used.
